_comment: The book's closed word lists (Tasheel al-Nahw), the only place they are written. Words are lemmas without harakat, as the parser spells them. Read by services/nahw_book.py; naming.py decides roles from these lists plus the parser's links. 'ambiguous' says when a listed word is something else, which is why the code also checks the links around the word. 'card' on a governing family: what a member is named on its own card (named), what it does (does), and the effect on a word linked to it that proves it governs here (governs: a governor or follower answer of services/syntax/facts.py, or a verb's case), and a member's own name where the book gives one (named_as), shorter on the bracket picture where the book's chart says less (chart, chart_as); read by naming._family and signs.py.

vetoes._comment: Links the book rules out, removed from the parser's choices before its tree is picked, and links it settles outright, written over the parser's tree after (mask.book_links). true = on. Read by services/syntax/mask.py.

jarr.effect: puts the noun after it in the genitive (majroor); the pair is jar-wa-majroor

ambiguous.و: oath (by Allah) vs conjunction vs waw al-ma'iyya vs resumptive; oath only when the next noun is the sworn-by name and no verb/noun precedes it in the clause
ambiguous.ت: oath only before الله (تالله); otherwise just a letter, e.g. a feminine ending or prefix of a present verb
ambiguous.ك: like (jarr) vs attached pronoun 'you' on a noun or verb (كتابك); jarr only on a word that is not itself a noun with the kaf as its last letter
ambiguous.ل: jarr lam vs lam al-amr (jazm, before a present verb) vs lam al-ta'kid (after inna) vs lam al-ta'lil (nasb, before a present verb); a noun after it means jarr, a present verb means amr or ta'lil
ambiguous.ب: jarr vs a prefix inside a word (بيت, بعد); only a jarr particle if the rest is a separate word
ambiguous.خلا: jarr vs exception verb (with ما it is a verb) vs the verb 'was empty'; see family exception
ambiguous.عدا: jarr vs exception verb vs verb 'passed'; see family exception
ambiguous.حاشا: jarr vs exception verb; see family exception
ambiguous.حتى: jarr vs conjunction vs a particle before a hidden أن with a present verb (nasb); a present verb after it means nasb, a noun means jarr or conjunction
ambiguous.على: preposition vs the proper name; in rare use a noun meaning 'above' after من
ambiguous.من: preposition vs relative 'who' vs interrogative 'who' vs conditional 'whoever'; preposition when a noun follows and no clause depends on it
ambiguous.في: preposition; also the name of the letter; no real rival
ambiguous.عن: preposition vs the verb-nun; practically none
ambiguous.مذ: preposition vs noun 'since' when a clause follows it
ambiguous.منذ: preposition vs noun 'since' when a clause follows it
ambiguous.رب: preposition; shown for completeness, governs an indefinite noun

card.does: يتبع ما بعده ما قبله في إعرابه

atf.effect: makes the next word follow the case of the word before it (معطوف on معطوف عليه); governs nothing itself

ambiguous.و: conjunction vs oath vs waw al-ma'iyya vs resumptive (واو الاستئناف) vs circumstantial (واو الحال); conjunction if the next word has the same case as the word before
ambiguous.ف: conjunction vs result/response (فاء الجواب, السببية) vs resumptive; conjunction when it joins two equals with quick sequence
ambiguous.ثم: conjunction vs the adverb 'there' (ثَمَّ); conjunction before a word that continues the sentence
ambiguous.حتى: conjunction vs jarr vs a particle before a hidden أن; conjunction only when the word after has the same case as the one before
ambiguous.أم: conjunction after a question with أ vs a connected/disconnected 'or'
ambiguous.أو: conjunction vs a particle with a hidden أن before a present verb (meaning 'until' or 'unless')
ambiguous.إما: conjunction (either-or) vs إن + ما in a condition
ambiguous.لا: conjunction (not X but Y) vs la of negation vs la of prohibition vs la of genus; conjunction only after an affirmative word with a preceding noun
ambiguous.بل: conjunction vs an 'idrab' particle opening a new sentence
ambiguous.لكن: conjunction (without shadda) vs لكنّ of inna's sisters; with shadda it is inna's sister

nida.effect: calls the noun after it (munada); a single definite munada is built on damma, else nasb
nida._called_nouns: أيّ (أيّة) with the ها of attention is the munada itself, built on damma; the noun with ال after it is its صفة (Tasheel, al-nida)

ambiguous.يا: vocative vs 'ya' of the speaker/dual ending on a noun; a particle only when it stands as its own word
ambiguous.أي: vocative (near) vs interrogative 'which' vs explanatory 'that is' (تفسير); vocative only when a noun is called right after it
ambiguous.أ: vocative (near) vs interrogative hamza; vocative if a noun then follows in calling sense, interrogative if a verb or full sentence follows
ambiguous.آ: vocative (far, lengthened) vs the exclamation آه
ambiguous.وا: lamentation (nudba) vs conjunction waw plus alif; only with a lament

istithna.effect: the word after it is the mustathna, usually nasb after a complete positive sentence; after غير/سوى it is genitive (mudaf ilayhi) and the tool itself takes the case

ambiguous.إلا: exception particle vs إن + لا (conditional 'if not', written apart in some texts) vs 'illa' of hasr (restriction) after a negation, where it is not exception but restriction
ambiguous.غير: exception noun vs plain noun meaning 'other than' used as an adjective (صفة), e.g. رجل غير مسلم
ambiguous.سوى: exception noun vs noun 'equal to / other than' used as an adjective
ambiguous.سواء: exception noun (rare) vs noun 'equal' in sentences of equality
ambiguous.ليس: verb of kana family vs exception verb; exception only with an implied pronoun subject and a mustathna after it

istithna_verbs.effect: before a noun in nasb a past verb that never changes (فعل ماضٍ جامد), its doer hidden (هو) and the noun its object; before a noun in jarr a preposition and the noun its majrur; after ما only the verb. Read by services/syntax/mask.py from the noun's typed case

ambiguous.خلا: exception verb or preposition vs the ordinary verb 'became empty' (خلا البيتُ: its noun in raf' is its doer)
ambiguous.عدا: exception verb or preposition vs the ordinary verb 'passed beyond'
ambiguous.حاشا: exception verb or preposition vs interjection 'far be it'

inna.effect: nasb the ism and raf' the khabar; attached ما cancels the effect (إنما)

ambiguous.إن: inna of emphasis vs conditional 'if' (إنْ, jazm) vs negative 'not' (إنْ) vs affirmative 'yes' (rare) vs a superfluous إن; inna when the next word is a noun in nasb or carries a pronoun suffix (إنه), conditional when a jazm verb follows, negative when followed by إلا or a noun with no nasb
ambiguous.أن: anna (emphasis; ism nasb) vs the nasb particle 'that' before a present verb vs tafsir أن vs the light أن in 'he knew that he would'; anna when a noun/pronoun suffix follows, nasb particle when a present verb follows
ambiguous.كأن: ka-anna 'as if' vs kaf + أن written apart; ka-anna nearly always
ambiguous.لكن: لكنّ with shadda (sister of inna) vs لكنْ without shadda (conjunction / idrab, no government)
ambiguous.لعل: la'alla 'maybe'; also the rare prefix form; no real rival

card.named: حرف عطف، ويجوز أن تكون استئنافية
card.said: الواو حرف عطف، ويجوز أن تكون استئنافية

istinaf.effect: a وَ before a noun with its own khabar after it (لا إله إلا الله واللهُ أكبرُ) joins two sentences, not two words: it may be read as joining them or as opening the second, so the card says both and the picture says حرف (particle_tree.json)

hasr.effect: after a negation with nothing before it in the case of the word after it (ما جاء إلا زيدٌ، لا إله إلا الله), إلا excepts nothing: it restricts, and the word after it takes the place the sentence leaves for it (Tasheel 3.8.7 p85, particle_tree.json)

card.does: تعمل عمل إن، تنصب الاسم وترفع الخبر

la_jins.effect: nasb the ism (built on fatha when indefinite and single) and raf' the khabar

ambiguous.لا: la of genus (indefinite noun right after, no tanween) vs la of prohibition (present verb, jazm) vs la that negates a present verb (no jazm) vs la of conjunction vs la hijaziyya (rare) vs la of nida-like oath; genus when a noun stands immediately after it and is nakira, prohibition when a present jazm verb follows, negation when an indicative verb follows

kana.effect: raf' the ism and nasb the khabar; all conjugated forms follow (كانوا، يكون، كن)

ambiguous.كان: complete verb 'existed/happened' (no khabar) vs defective; defective when a khabar follows the ism, complete when it stands with only a subject
ambiguous.صار: defective 'became' vs complete verb 'went to / turned into' with a preposition
ambiguous.أصبح: defective 'became' vs complete verb 'entered the morning'
ambiguous.أمسى: defective 'became' vs complete verb 'entered the evening'
ambiguous.أضحى: defective 'became' vs complete verb 'entered the forenoon'
ambiguous.بات: defective 'spent the night in a state' vs complete verb 'spent the night'
ambiguous.زال: defective with a negation before it (ما زال) vs complete verb 'ceased / passed away' without it
ambiguous.برح: defective with a negation vs complete verb 'left'
ambiguous.فتئ: defective with a negation vs complete verb
ambiguous.انفك: defective with a negation vs complete verb 'got loose'
ambiguous.دام: defective with ما (ما دام) vs complete verb 'lasted'
ambiguous.ليس: defective 'is not' vs an exception verb after a positive sentence

kana.note: ما زال / ما دام / لا يزال are the verb plus its negation, read as two words, so they are not listed a second time; ما alone acts like ليس (tarkeeb.json ma_hijaziyya)

card.named: ناقص من أفعال المقاربة والرجاء والشروع

kaada.effect: raf' the ism; the khabar is a present verb (usually with أن after أوشك and عسى, without it after كاد and the verbs of commencement)

ambiguous.كاد: verb of proximity vs the ordinary verb 'to plot' (كاد يكيد) or 'to cheat', where it has a normal object
ambiguous.عسى: verb of hope vs the pronoun-suffix form ('perhaps he', عساه); both are still this family
ambiguous.أخذ: commencement 'began' (followed by a present verb) vs ordinary 'took' (followed by a noun object)
ambiguous.جعل: commencement 'began' (followed by a present verb) vs ordinary 'made/placed' (two objects, see family zanna)
ambiguous.هب: commencement (rare) vs the imperative 'suppose' of zanna (هب زيدا صديقا)
ambiguous.بدأ: commencement 'began' followed by a present verb vs ordinary 'started X' with a noun object
ambiguous.أقبل: commencement 'set about' vs ordinary 'approached / turned toward'

kaada.note: جعل and هب are also in zanna, as the book lists them in both: a verb here counts only when a present verb completes it

zanna.effect: both objects are nasb and their subject-predicate pair is mubtada-khabar in origin; the verb enters a nominal sentence

ambiguous.علم: zanna-type 'knew that X was Y' (two objects) vs 'knew X' (one object) vs noun 'flag / science' vs the passive/intensive form 'taught'
ambiguous.رأى: zanna-type 'considered' (two objects) vs 'saw with the eye' (one object)
ambiguous.وجد: zanna-type 'found X to be Y' (two objects) vs 'found' (one object) vs 'felt'
ambiguous.ظن: zanna-type 'thought' (two objects) vs 'suspected' with a noun object in rare text
ambiguous.حسب: zanna-type 'reckoned' (two objects) vs noun 'enough' (حَسْب) vs preposition-like 'according to' (حسب)
ambiguous.زعم: zanna-type 'claimed' vs ordinary 'claimed' with أن; nearly the same
ambiguous.هب: zanna-type 'suppose' (imperative) vs commencement verb in kaada family
ambiguous.جعل: zanna-type 'made X into Y' (two objects) vs commencement 'began' (kaada family)
ambiguous.اتخذ: 'took X as Y' (two objects) vs 'took X' (one object)
ambiguous.تخذ: 'took X as Y' (two objects) vs 'took X' (one object)
ambiguous.صير: 'made X into Y' (two objects) vs stem of صار
ambiguous.رد: 'turned X into Y' (two objects) vs 'returned X' (one object)
ambiguous.ترك: 'left X as Y' (two objects) vs 'left X' (one object)

two_objects_give.ar: أفعال تنصب مفعولين ليس أصلهما مبتدأ وخبر
two_objects_give.effect: takes two objects that are not mubtada/khabar; the verbs of informing take a third object

ambiguous.سأل: 'asked X for Y' (two objects) vs 'asked about Y' with عن
ambiguous.أرى: 'showed' (two objects, or three when with 'know') vs 'I see' (first person present of رأى)
ambiguous.حدث: 'told' (two or three objects) vs 'happened' (intransitive, appears in the same spelling)
ambiguous.منع: 'prevented X from Y' (two objects, the second with من) vs ordinary one-object use

nasb_mudari.effect: puts the present verb after it in nasb (fatha; the nun of the five verbs is dropped)
nasb_mudari._merges: a word written with a shadda on its lam is أن (this family) with the nun merged into a following لا: أَلَّا = أَنْ + لا. `named` is the name of the head, `tail` the family the piece after it works as (particles.stamp).
nasb_mudari._before_a_present_verb: the ones that settle an unvowelled present verb as منصوب when it comes straight after them; the rest need a reading of the sentence (services/syntax/naming.py)

ambiguous.أن: nasb particle vs anna (see inna) vs the explanatory أن; nasb when a present verb follows
ambiguous.كي: nasb particle 'so that' vs the different word كيف 'how'; nasb when a present verb follows
ambiguous.إذن: nasb particle only when at the start of the answer and followed by a present verb; otherwise a plain adverb 'then'
ambiguous.لن: always nasb particle; no real rival
ambiguous.حتى: hidden-أن nasb vs jarr vs conjunction; nasb when a present verb follows
ambiguous.لام التعليل: lam of purpose, nasb with hidden أن; see jarr ل
ambiguous.فاء السببية: fa of cause after request (amr, nahi, istifham, tamanni, ard, tahdid), nasb with hidden أن
ambiguous.واو المعية: waw of accompaniment with hidden أن; see jarr و

jazm.effect: puts the present verb after it in jazm (sukun; nun of the five verbs dropped; a weak last letter dropped); conditionals govern two verbs, the condition and the result
jazm._conditional_inflected: the one conditional noun that takes a case ending (أيُّ، أيَّ، أيِّ); every other is built (مبني), in the place of its case (Tasheel)
jazm._conditional_adverbs: the conditional nouns that name a time or a place: each stands in the place of a ظرف, منصوب (Tasheel). The others (مَنْ، ما، مهما) stand as the مبتدأ when their verb already has its object (services/syntax/naming.py)
jazm._conditional_nouns: the conditional nouns (Tasheel: the jazm conditionals other than إن and إذما). Each has rivals (relative, question), so one opens a condition only when it leads its clause, a verb comes straight after, and an answer follows (services/syntax/condition.py)
jazm._conditional_particles: the conditional particles (the other conditionals are nouns): with a verb straight after, a condition opens; its first verb is فعل الشرط and its answer جواب الشرط, both in jazm or in its place (services/rule_engine.py)
jazm._before_a_present_verb: the ones that settle an unvowelled present verb as مجزوم when it comes straight after them; لا and the conditionals need a reading of the sentence (services/syntax/naming.py)

ambiguous.لا: prohibition (jazm) vs negation (no jazm) vs la of genus; prohibition when it is followed by a present jussive verb
ambiguous.ل: lam al-amr (jazm) vs jarr lam vs lam al-ta'kid vs lam al-ta'lil; amr when it is attached to a present verb and means 'let him'
ambiguous.لما: jazm particle 'not yet' (followed by a present verb) vs 'when' adverb (followed by a past verb) vs lamma 'only' in لما + إلا
ambiguous.إن: conditional 'if' (jazm) vs inna (emphasis) vs negative 'not'; conditional when it opens a condition and is followed by two verbs
ambiguous.من: conditional noun 'whoever' (jazm) vs relative 'who' vs interrogative 'who' vs preposition; conditional when it leads two jazm verbs
ambiguous.ما: conditional 'whatever' vs relative vs interrogative vs negation; conditional only when it starts a clause and is followed by two jazm verbs
ambiguous.متى: conditional 'whenever' vs interrogative 'when'; conditional when two jazm verbs follow, interrogative when a question ends it
ambiguous.أين: conditional 'wherever' vs interrogative 'where'; conditional when two jazm verbs follow
ambiguous.أي: conditional 'whichever' vs interrogative 'which' vs vocative 'O' vs explanatory 'that is'
ambiguous.إذما: conditional particle 'if ever' (Tasheel note 1 calls it a particle, not a noun)
ambiguous.لم: always jazm 'did not'; no real rival

negation.effect: negates the sentence; some govern (لن، لم، لما، لات), and ما and لا act like ليس in some sentences (see family kana in tarkeeb.json)

ambiguous.ما: negation vs relative 'that which' vs interrogative 'what' vs conditional 'whatever' vs masdariyya ('as long as') vs ما الكافة after inna/kana; negation when followed by a verb or a nominal sentence and means 'not'
ambiguous.لا: negation of a present verb vs prohibition (jazm) vs la of genus vs conjunction vs an extra/emphatic لا; negation when a present indicative verb follows
ambiguous.إن: negation 'not' (إنْ, before إلا or a nominal sentence) vs inna vs conditional
ambiguous.لات: negation working like ليس (for time words only); rare
ambiguous.لن: negation of the future with nasb; covered in nasb_mudari
ambiguous.لم: negation of the past with jazm; covered in jazm
ambiguous.لما: negation 'not yet' with jazm; also 'when'; covered in jazm
ambiguous.ليس: a verb of kana family that negates; covered in kana

ghair_amila_other.effect: draws attention, answers, explains, urges, or adds a nuance; governs nothing
ghair_amila_other._conditional_particles: the non-jussive conditional particles that open a condition before a verb (Year 3 notes, zuroof p4: لولا، لوما، لو، أمّا are حروف). لولا and لوما open one only before a noun and urge before a verb; أمّا comes before a noun: so only لو. Read with jazm's list by nahw_book.condition_of

ambiguous.أما: notification/detail 'as for' (أما ... فـ) vs أم + ما (interrogative) vs أما الاستفتاحية
ambiguous.ألا: notification 'lo!' vs exhortation 'why not' vs أن + لا (written together) vs أ + لا (question with negation)
ambiguous.ها: notification particle vs attached pronoun 'her' vs the ha of demonstratives (هذا); notification when it stands alone or is fused with a demonstrative
ambiguous.أي: explanatory 'that is' vs vocative vs interrogative 'which'
ambiguous.لولا: exhortation 'why not' (before a verb) vs conditional 'if not for' (before a noun, its khabar omitted)
ambiguous.لوما: exhortation vs conditional 'if not for'; same pattern as لولا
ambiguous.قد: anticipation/tahqiq/taqlil (before a verb) vs 'enough' (قدْ) as a noun; particle when a verb follows
ambiguous.كلا: rebuke 'never' vs كلا 'both' (see tawkeed), same spelling; rebuke when alone or before a verb
ambiguous.س: future prefix on a present verb vs a letter inside a noun; particle when attached to a present verb
ambiguous.أ: interrogative hamza vs vocative أ vs first-person present prefix (أفعل)
ambiguous.لو: conditional 'if' (non-governing) vs wish 'would that' vs masdariyya
ambiguous.نعم: affirmation 'yes' vs the verb of praise 'what an excellent' (see family praise_blame)
ambiguous.بلى: 'yes, indeed' answering a negative; no real rival
ambiguous.إي: 'yes' (before an oath) vs the exclamation إيه

praise_blame.effect: a verb of praise/blame is followed by its subject (definite noun or a hidden pronoun plus a specifier) and then the praised/blamed; wonder forms are fixed patterns

ambiguous.نعم: verb of praise 'what an excellent' vs the particle 'yes' (see ghair_amila_other)
ambiguous.بئس: verb of blame vs the noun 'evil' in some adjectival phrases
ambiguous.ساء: verb of blame (as بئس) vs ordinary 'was bad / harmed'
ambiguous.حبذا: 'how lovely it is' fixed phrase; the noun after it is the praised

istifham.effect: turns the sentence into a question; the particles govern nothing, the nouns take a role in the sentence (subject, object, adverb, ...)
istifham._before_verb: The place a question noun fills when it opens a verb clause whose verb has no object of its own (Tasheel 2.4.7 p47): what or how many is asked is the object (ماذا قرأت، كم كتابًا قرأت), how is the hal (كيف جئت), when and where the maf'ul fihi (متى سافر، أين جلس). Read by services/syntax/facts.py.
istifham._inflected: the one question noun that takes a case ending and a مضاف إليه (أيُّ الأعمالِ أفضلُ: أيّ the mubtada, الأعمال its مضاف إليه); every other is built, and the noun hung on it is what is asked about (متى السفرُ: السفر the mubtada). Read by services/syntax/facts.py.

ambiguous.أ: interrogative hamza vs vocative hamza vs first-person present prefix; interrogative if at the very start of a sentence before a full clause
ambiguous.من: interrogative 'who' vs relative 'who' vs conditional 'whoever' vs preposition; interrogative when the sentence ends with a question mark or has no other clause
ambiguous.ما: interrogative 'what' vs relative vs negation vs conditional; interrogative when it is the first word and the clause is a question
ambiguous.ماذا: 'what is this' (interrogative) vs relative ('that which') with ذا; interrogative in a question
ambiguous.كم: interrogative 'how many' vs exclamatory 'so many' (كم الخبرية)
ambiguous.لم: interrogative contraction 'why' (لِمَ) vs jazm lam; interrogative when it has a question mark and is followed by a verb in the ordinary tense
ambiguous.أم: connected 'or' in a question vs conjunction
ambiguous.بم: contraction of ب + ما 'by what'; interrogative

tawkeed.effect: follows the word it emphasises (muakkad) in case, gender and number; the first group (نفسه، عينه، كله) carries a pronoun joined to the tawkeed word that refers back to the muakkad

ambiguous.نفس: emphasis 'itself' (with pronoun suffix, after a definite noun) vs noun 'soul / self'
ambiguous.عين: emphasis 'itself' (with pronoun suffix) vs noun 'eye / spring'
ambiguous.كل: emphasis 'all of it' (with pronoun suffix, after a noun) vs ordinary mudaf noun 'every / all' before an indefinite noun (كل رجل) or a definite plural
ambiguous.جميع: emphasis 'all' (with pronoun suffix) vs ordinary noun 'all' as mudaf or hal
ambiguous.كلا: emphasis 'both' (with pronoun suffix, masculine dual) vs ordinary mudaf 'both' vs rebuke particle كلا; CAMeL spells it كلى (كلتى) before the pronoun, so the list holds both
ambiguous.كلتا: emphasis 'both' (with pronoun suffix, feminine dual) vs ordinary mudaf 'both'
ambiguous.أجمع: emphasis after كل (كله أجمع); hardly used as an ordinary word
ambiguous.جمع: see جمعاء and أجمع; rarely used as tawkeed without the pattern

zarf_zaman.effect: adverb of time (maf'ul fihi), nasb, or mudaf; a few are built (mabni) as in إذ إذا متى
zarf_zaman._carriers: A word of whole or part added to a time or place word stands in its place as the maf'ul fihi (كلَّ يومٍ، بعضَ الليلِ).
zarf_zaman._conditional_nouns: إذا before a past verb is a time word holding the meaning of a condition, not jussive (Tasheel 4.3.1 p112): its own clause is in the place of jarr as its مضاف إليه. Read with jazm's list by nahw_book.condition_of; particle_tree.json tells it from إذا الفجائية.

ambiguous.إذ: adverb 'when' (past) vs preposition-like 'since / then' vs a particle of surprise
ambiguous.أمس: adverb 'yesterday' vs plain noun (when mudaf or with al); adverbial when it modifies a verb
ambiguous.غدا: adverb 'tomorrow' vs plain noun 'tomorrow' used as mubtada or khabar
ambiguous.الآن: adverb 'now' vs noun after a preposition (من الآن)
ambiguous.قط: adverb 'never' (used with a past negation) vs noun 'cat' (قِطّ)
ambiguous.أبدا: adverb 'ever' vs noun 'eternity' after a preposition
ambiguous.يوم: adverb 'day' vs plain noun 'day' as mubtada, khabar, mudaf ilayhi, or majroor
ambiguous.صباحا: adverb 'in the morning' vs plain noun (hal or masdar)
ambiguous.مساء: adverb 'in the evening' vs plain noun 'evening'
ambiguous.ليلا: adverb 'by night' vs plain noun 'night' (hal) when a pronoun is attached
ambiguous.ضحى: adverb 'forenoon' vs plain noun / also the name of a prayer
ambiguous.عشاء: adverb 'in the evening' vs plain noun 'supper / the isha prayer'
ambiguous.حين: adverb 'when' vs plain noun 'time' (after a preposition or as mudaf)
ambiguous.وقت: adverb 'at the time of' vs plain noun 'time'
ambiguous.ساعة: adverb 'at the hour of' vs plain noun 'hour / the Hour'
ambiguous.عام: adverb 'in the year' vs plain noun 'year' vs adjective 'general'
ambiguous.سنة: adverb 'in the year' vs plain noun 'year / sunna'
ambiguous.شهر: adverb 'in the month' vs plain noun 'month'
ambiguous.أسبوع: adverb 'in the week' vs plain noun 'week'
ambiguous.يوما: adverb 'some day' vs plain noun 'a day' as object or hal
ambiguous.لما: adverb 'when' (before a past verb) vs jazm 'not yet' vs only (لما + إلا)
ambiguous.قبل: adverb 'before' vs plain mudaf noun (بعد / قبل after من); needs the next noun
ambiguous.بعد: adverb 'after' vs plain mudaf noun; also the word 'after' in بعد أن
ambiguous.لدن: adverb 'from the time of' vs none; see also zarf_makan
ambiguous.حينا: adverb 'for a while' vs plain noun
ambiguous.دهرا: adverb 'for ages' vs plain noun 'time / era'

zarf_makan.effect: adverb of place (maf'ul fihi), nasb, or mudaf; حيث is built and is followed by a clause; the rest are usually mudaf to a noun

ambiguous.حيث: adverb 'where' (built, takes a clause) vs none; always adverbial
ambiguous.عند: adverb 'at / near' vs noun after a preposition (من عند) vs the plain mudaf
ambiguous.لدى: adverb 'at / by' vs plain noun after a preposition
ambiguous.مع: adverb 'with' (so gives company) vs a plain noun after a preposition (من مع)
ambiguous.بين: adverb 'between' vs plain noun 'separation / distance' (البين) vs preposition-like
ambiguous.فوق: adverb 'above' vs plain mudaf noun after من, or adjective
ambiguous.تحت: adverb 'below' vs plain mudaf noun after من
ambiguous.أمام: adverb 'in front of' vs plain noun 'imam' (إمام, different spelling) or mudaf after من
ambiguous.قدام: adverb 'in front of' vs plain mudaf
ambiguous.وراء: adverb 'behind' vs plain mudaf noun after من
ambiguous.دون: adverb 'below / without' vs plain noun 'lesser' (دون الحد) or preposition-like 'besides'
ambiguous.حول: adverb 'around' vs plain noun 'power' (حَوْل) or verb 'turned'
ambiguous.يمين: adverb 'right of' vs plain noun 'right hand / oath'
ambiguous.شمال: adverb 'left of' vs plain noun 'north / left hand'
ambiguous.يسار: adverb 'left of' vs plain noun 'left / wealth'
ambiguous.قبل: adverb 'before' vs plain mudaf after من; see zarf_zaman
ambiguous.بعد: adverb 'after' vs plain mudaf after من; see zarf_zaman
ambiguous.هنا: adverb 'here'; always adverbial (also a demonstrative of place)
ambiguous.وسط: adverb 'in the middle of' vs plain noun 'middle / milieu'
ambiguous.داخل: adverb 'inside' vs plain active participle or noun
ambiguous.خارج: adverb 'outside' vs plain active participle or noun
ambiguous.بإزاء: composed form 'opposite'; jar-majroor in form, adverbial in meaning
ambiguous.مكان: adverb 'in place of' vs plain noun 'place'
ambiguous.يمينا: adverb 'to the right' vs plain noun 'an oath'
ambiguous.شمالا: adverb 'to the left' vs plain noun

mawsul.effect: heads a relative clause (sila) whose returning pronoun (aid) refers back to it; the clause is the relative's complement, and the relative fills a role in the outer sentence

ambiguous.ما: relative 'that which' vs interrogative vs negation vs conditional; relative when it means 'that which' and is followed by a clause with a returning pronoun
ambiguous.من: relative 'the one who' vs interrogative vs conditional vs preposition; relative when it means 'he who' and is followed by a clause with a returning pronoun
ambiguous.أي: relative 'whichever' vs interrogative vs conditional vs vocative
ambiguous.ذو: relative (Tayy dialect, rare) vs ordinary noun 'owner of' (ذو مال)
ambiguous.ذا: relative after ما or من interrogatives (ماذا) vs demonstrative 'this'
ambiguous.ال: relative (when attached to an active or passive participle: المكتوب) vs definite article; relative only when it attaches to a participle and can be rephrased by 'the one who'
ambiguous.اللات: rare plural feminine relative vs the idol name اللات in historical text

ishara.effect: points to a thing; nearly always mabni (fixed case); as the subject or complement it takes a role; the noun with ال after it is the مشار إليه (a صفة or بدل)

ambiguous.ذا: demonstrative 'this' vs relative after ما or من vs part of ماذا; demonstrative on its own
ambiguous.هنا: demonstrative of place vs plain adverb 'here'; see zarf_makan
ambiguous.هناك: demonstrative of place vs plain adverb 'there'
ambiguous.ها: attention particle vs attached pronoun; in هذا it is the tanbih prefix
ambiguous.ذلك: demonstrative 'that' vs the compound لِذَلِك 'therefore' (ل + ذلك): jar-majroor; same reading
ambiguous.ذي: demonstrative 'this (f)' vs the genitive/accusative of ذو 'owner of' (ذي مال)

damir_munfasil.effect: stands as its own word: mubtada, khabar, or or a fasl pronoun, a separator between mubtada and khabar that has no i'raab position of its own; in the object slot only إيا plus suffix works

ambiguous.هو: pronoun 'he' vs fasl pronoun between mubtada and khabar (shown in tarkeeb.json subject_words.opens_sentence)
ambiguous.هي: pronoun 'she' vs fasl pronoun; unambiguous as a word
ambiguous.هم: pronoun 'they' vs plural attached pronoun 'their' when suffixed to a word; standalone only as a pronoun
ambiguous.إيا: object pronoun base (subject_words.object_pronoun in tarkeeb.json); always followed by an attached pronoun
ambiguous.أنا: pronoun 'I' vs the letter combination in أنا + ألف الإطلاق; unambiguous

damir_muttasil.effect: written joined to the word before it: genitive/accusative suffix on nouns, verbs and particles (كتابه، ضربه، إنه), or the subject ending of a verb

ambiguous.ك: attached pronoun 'your' / 'you' vs jarr kaf 'like'; see jarr
ambiguous.ه: attached pronoun 'him / his' vs ha of the feminine / ha of rest at the end of a word (هاء السكت)
ambiguous.ها: attached pronoun 'her' vs the tanbih ha (هذا) vs ha of rest
ambiguous.ت: subject ending (I / you) on a past verb vs feminine ta of the noun (ة) vs the prefix of a present verb
ambiguous.ا: dual subject ending on a verb vs the alif of a dual noun vs tanween alif
ambiguous.و: plural subject ending on a verb vs conjunction waw vs oath; plural ending only when attached to a verb form
ambiguous.ن: feminine plural subject ending vs nun of emphasis vs nun of the five verbs vs nun of the dual / plural
ambiguous.ي: first-person suffix 'my / me' vs ya of the feminine singular present or imperative vs ya of nisba
ambiguous.تما: dual subject ending on a past verb; unambiguous
ambiguous.تم: plural-masculine subject ending on a past verb vs none
ambiguous.تن: plural-feminine subject ending on a past verb vs none

ismfil.effect: a noun that does the work of a verb; past-meaning ones give raf' to the noun after, command-meaning ones give nasb

ambiguous.بله: noun-of-verb 'leave alone' vs preposition-like 'let alone / not to mention'
ambiguous.عليك: noun-of-verb 'you must' vs preposition + pronoun (على + ك); noun-of-verb when it carries a command
ambiguous.رويد: noun-of-verb 'slowly' vs diminutive of 'slow' used as adverb

tamyeez_head.ar: ألفاظ العدد والمقادير التي يأتي بعدها التمييز
tamyeez_head.effect: a tamyeez (specifier) is named only after the numbers 11 to 99, كم, or a measure: عشرون كتابا، رطل عسلا. Hundreds and thousands take a genitive مضاف إليه instead (مئة كتاب)

participle_patterns.ar: أوزان اسم الفاعل واسم المفعول والصفة المشبهة
participle_patterns.effect: an indefinite accusative word of one of these shapes, after a verb with its doer, is a hal (a derived describing word, Tasheel 3.8.6). Prefixes of the analyser's own pattern string (1 2 3 are the root letters): 1ا2ِ3 is فاعل (آ2ِ3 when the first root letter is a hamza: آمِر، آكِل), 1ا2ِي the same with a weak last letter (باكية، داعيًا), مُ is every active or passive participle of forms II to X, مَ1ْ2ُو3 is مفعول; the صفة مشبهة: 1َ2ِ3 فَعِل (فَرِحًا), 1َ2ِي3 فَعِيل (سَعِيدًا), 1َ2ْ3َان فَعْلان (غَضْبَانَ).

masdar_patterns.effect: an indefinite accusative word of one of these shapes is a masdar (شُكْرًا، صَبْرًا، تَسْلِيمًا, إِكْرَامًا). Prefixes of the analyser's own pattern string (1 2 3 are the root letters): the common Form I measures فَعْل، فُعْل، فِعْل، فَعَل، فُعُول، فِعَال، فُعَال، and Forms II and IV تَفْعِيل، إِفْعَال.

ta_merges.book: Tasheel al-Sarf, Forms V and VI
ta_merges.effect: a present verb of Form V or VI with two ta' (تَتَطَوَّعُ) may merge its second ta' into the stem's first letter when that letter is one of these, and shows it by a shadda on it (تَطَّوَّعُ). A past verb of those forms (تَطَوَّعَ) has no shadda there; a past of two or three letters (تَمَّ) is not of these forms.

six_nouns.effect: as a مضاف (not to the ya of the speaker) the case is a letter, not a vowel: و raf', ا nasb, ي jarr (جاء أخو زيد، رأيت أخا زيد، مررت بأخي زيد). هن is left out: it usually takes the vowels.

tamyeez_verbs.effect: after a complete sentence built on one of these, an indefinite accusative noun is a tamyeez of the relation: طاب المكان هواء، امتلأ الكوب ماء. Lemmas as the parser spells them (a hamzat-wasl verb comes back with alef wasla).
